summary: Frontend UI verified 4 new flows: (1) OozSnoozePanel CRUD on /attendance — create/edit/delete rows appear correctly with Active pill and empty state returns after delete. (2) Desktop leave conflict dialog on /leave — dialog opens with correct branch/coworker text ('Approving Foday Massaquoi's leave puts 2+ of Ministry of Finance HQ's 6 staff off the same day'), Cancel keeps pending, Approve anyway approves. (3) Mobile conflict bottom-sheet on /m/leave (390x844) — sheet renders with 'Adama Sankoh' colleague name and dates, Approve anyway approves. (4) PayslipScanPanel on /payroll — after 5 unauth GET /api/public/payslip/{vid} scans, the row shows scan_count=5, red 'Unusual' flag, and click-to-expand history lists 5 timestamped scan entries.
critical_code_review_comments: MobileLeave.jsx renders reports of ALL statuses (approved/rejected included) under the 'Waiting on you' section — mildly misleading header when items are already decided; consider filtering to pending only or renaming the section.
OozSnoozePanel remove() calls window native confirm implicitly (no confirm dialog) — deletion is destructive with no undo/confirmation; consider adding a confirm step.
PayslipScanPanel: no pagination — could grow unbounded for high-scan tenants.
